verdict.summary: US tree is technically reachable but commercially weak: broken canonicals, fabricated review schema, entity fact contradictions, and 118 blog posts with zero links into money pages. Five critical and four high findings block trustworthy AI citation and SERP conversion.

easyWins.action: Fix the canonical pointing at www.rytsense.com
easyWins.rationale: Wrong-host canonical leaks US/global authority and confuses index selection.

easyWins.action: Remove placeholder zero values from server-rendered HTML
easyWins.rationale: Visible zeros look like empty metrics to users and AI extractors.
Fake review markup is a trust and rich-result risk.

easyWins.action: Publish a single source-of-truth entity facts block (headcount, projects, cities)
easyWins.rationale: Five conflicting headcounts and project counts poison AI answers.

easyWins.action: Add hub links from top blog posts into primary /us/ service pages
easyWins.rationale: Blog corpus has zero commercial internal links today.
No security/compliance surface for enterprise buyers or AI trust signals.

easyWins.action: Fix US self-declared location claims that 404
easyWins.rationale: Declared US presence pages return 404 — brand SERP and trust damage.

easyWins.action: Align global vs /us/ title/H1 intent to reduce cannibalization
easyWins.rationale: Both trees target the same English commercial queries.

easyWins.action: Add named client logos/case studies on US service pages
easyWins.rationale: 31 case studies lack named clients; weak E-E-A-T for commercial SERPs.
Brand SERP currently resolves toward job-review style sites.

easyWins.action: Add FAQ answer blocks with extractable first sentences on top 5 US pages
easyWins.rationale: Improves AEO chunk retrieval without waiting for full content rebuild.

easyWins.action: Wire Organization sameAs to verified profiles only
easyWins.rationale: Entity grounding fails when sameAs and on-page facts disagree.

easyWins.action: 301 map legacy rytsense.com paths still linked internally
easyWins.rationale: Stops soft-404 and host leakage from legacy brand domain.

easyWins.action: Add breadcrumb + Service schema only where visible content matches
easyWins.rationale: Replace invalid markup with honest, visible structured data.

easyWins.action: Add named engineers to Meet the Experts
easyWins.rationale: Named experts improve E-E-A-T and AI citation accuracy.

criticalIssues.title: Placeholder zeros in server HTML
criticalIssues.detail: At least 2 pages ship literal zero placeholders in server-rendered HTML, readable by crawlers and AI agents.

criticalIssues.title: Broken canonical to www.rytsense.com
criticalIssues.detail: Freight broker ROI calculator (and related) canonicalizes to the wrong host, splitting index signals.

criticalIssues.title: Fabricated review schema
criticalIssues.detail: AggregateRating / review JSON-LD present without verifiable on-page reviews.

criticalIssues.title: No security / compliance page
criticalIssues.detail: Enterprise buyers and trust-sensitive AI prompts find no authoritative compliance surface under /us/.

criticalIssues.title: 118 blog posts with zero money-page links
criticalIssues.detail: Large content corpus is commercially orphaned — no internal links into primary service URLs.

highIssues.title: Five conflicting headcounts
highIssues.detail: About/US pages disagree on company size across five distinct figures.

highIssues.title: US self-declared pages that 404
highIssues.detail: Navigation or copy claims US presence URLs that return 404.

highIssues.title: Brand SERP resolves to job-review sites
highIssues.detail: Branded queries surface third-party job/review properties ahead of owned assets.

highIssues.title: 31 case studies with zero named clients
highIssues.detail: Case study corpus lacks attributable client names, weakening proof and citations.
